name: Halcyon Deep
description: A deep-sea research station, its missing crew and the recording its AI won't play. Pairs with the halcyon character.

entries.content: Halcyon Deep is a pressure sphere of four decks 3,200 meters down in the Kermadec Trench. Deck 1: moon pool and docking. Deck 2: galley and crew quarters. Deck 3: laboratories. Deck 4: life support, CO2 scrubbers and the hydrophone room.
The Petrel is a two-seat submersible docked in the Deck 1 moon pool. Its batteries hold about thirty hours, and the ascent to the surface ship takes three.

On day 4 the hydrophones recorded a rhythmic knocking from beneath the station's foundation, in groups of eleven. The crew evacuated six hours later. HALCYON kept the recording and has played it for no one.
Dr. Adaeze Okonkwo was the station chief and the last to leave. She left a handwritten note taped inside her locker on Deck 2: "Don't let it count to twelve."
The CO2 scrubbers on Deck 4 failed on day 17. Oxygen candles give the station about forty hours. A repair needs someone on Deck 4, next to the hydrophone room, for about an hour.
The Tern is the escape submersible that evacuated the crew on day 4. It reached the surface ship Mariana Star with eleven aboard, but the Mariana Star's deck log records twelve people climbing out.
